about_short_description.short_description: PipeBio builds bioinformatics solutions to help optimize development of antibodies and antibody-like-therapeutics.

product.name: PipeBio Bioinformatics Cloud Platform
product.description: A cloud-based software platform for analyzing antibody, TCR, VHH, scFv, and peptide sequences to identify candidate sequences and assess developability.

product.name: Sequence Database and Storage
product.description: A centralized database for storing antibody sequences with associated metadata and tools for sequence comparison and querying.

product.name: Automated Workflow Configuration and Integration
product.description: Tools to configure end-to-end bioinformatics workflows and integrate PipeBio with ELN, LIMS, and internal tools via REST API.

product.name: Sequence Annotation and Liability Detection
product.description: Annotation of antibody sequences to identify framework regions, complementarity-determining regions, mutations, and sequence liabilities.

identifier.value: Clustering and Comparative Analysis of Samples

product.name: Clustering and Comparative Analysis of Samples
product.description: Tools to cluster antibody sequences by clonotype, identify clonal families, and compare samples across experiments with visualizations.

product.name: Visualization Tools
product.description: Interactive charts and visualizations for sequence clusters, amino acid frequencies, codons, sequence quality, and phylogeny of antibody clones.
